prompts.sprites: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production pixel-art spritesheet for Shattered Pixel Dungeon. Input image 1 is the identity reference: a stubborn cute black-and-white chubby young cow, dark angry eyebrows, little cream horns, pink muzzle, pale round belly, black hooves. Input image 2 is the sprite STYLE reference ONLY, showing the tiny classic pixel dungeon human animations. Replace the human with that cow identity. Create one transparent sprite sheet, EXACTLY 7 columns by 3 rows of evenly spaced square cells, 21 isolated cow sprites, NO grid lines and NO text. Every sprite uses the SAME tiny 12-by-15-pixel logical sprite resolution, rendered as big crisp nearest-neighbor square pixels; dark charcoal outline, restricted 10-color palette, compact white round body and black hair/ears and hooves, two cream horns, two dark diagonal eyebrows, pale pink wide muzzle. In row-major order poses: 1 standing front-right three-quarter, 2 standing blink, 3 right-facing walking left foot forward, 4 walking passing, 5 walking right foot forward, 6 walking passing, 7 walking stride; row 2: 8 walking passing, 9 hurt startled, 10 crouch hurt, 11 fallen onto side, 12 eyes-closed collapsed, 13 collapsed flatter, 14 attack preparing tilted forward; row 3: 15 horns thrust forward attack, 16 attack recover, 17 bending to operate, 18 operating lower, 19 airborne legs raised, 20 reading a small parchment, 21 parchment lifted. All face right except front three-quarter idle; each entirely within its cell, consistent baseline where appropriate. Small pale turquoise neckerchief on all sprites. True hard pixel art with broad connected pixel clusters, no 3D lighting, no smooth curves, no antialiasing, no gradients, no blurring. Transparent background, no shadows. This is a tiny in-game sprite, visual clarity at very low resolution is essential. Identity MUST look like the reference cow, not a human or generic cow on four legs. No text or decorative panels.
prompts.icons: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art item and ability icon sheet for a cute stubborn cow hero in Shattered Pixel Dungeon. Make EXACTLY 12 clearly separated isolated icons in an evenly spaced 6-column by 2-row grid. No gridlines, no labels, no text. Very crisp classic low-resolution dungeon pixel art, each icon designed to fit a logical 16x16 pixel tile, shown enlarged with perfectly square pixels, dark charcoal 1-pixel outline and 4-tone shading, no antialiasing, no glow bleeding. Transparent background with large gaps between icons. Row 1 icons left to right: (1) diagonal short dark wooden mace with a small double cow-horn ivory head, copper binding, (2) worn bronze cowbell with teal ribbon and loop, (3) squat glass milk bottle full of white milk with tan cork and tiny blue ribbon, (4) black-and-white spotted cloth bib cuirass with simple brown straps, (5) wooden round shield carrying a green grass tuft and small ivory cow horn emblem, (6) a round green hay-and-oat biscuit with a tiny golden star. Row 2 icons left to right: (7) cute angry black-and-white young cow HEAD PORTRAIT, short ivory horns, broad eyebrows, pink muzzle; (8) horned dark cow head in orange angular impact burst symbol of aggressive groundshaker class; (9) horned cow head with teal crescent shield symbol of gentle protector class; (10) pair of sharp ivory cow horns charging right with two amber motion streaks symbol of stampede; (11) teal wooden round shield encircling two green grass blades and small stars symbol of pasture ward; (12) golden tiny sun above a teal crescent moon with one silver star symbol of midnight sun. All 12 should have distinct readable silhouettes, same tiny-scale pixel style. No typography or extra decorative elements. Use the provided cow as identity reference for cow portrait icons, but fully pixelate the design and simplify for 16x16 logical resolution.
prompts.splash: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: fullscreen hero-selection splash art for a Shattered Pixel Dungeon mod. Landscape 16:9 composition, no lettering, no logo, no UI. Transform the provided stubborn black-and-white cow mascot into a brave tiny dungeon adventurer in elegant handmade pixel art. Keep its short cream horns, thick expressive dark eyebrows, dark floppy ears, pink muzzle, pale round belly, black hooves and stubborn expression. The cow stands just right of center at about 62% of canvas width, full body visible, proudly holding a short double-horn mace with wood shaft and wearing a teal neckerchief plus bronze cowbell and a black-and-white patchwork cloth bib. Scene: moss-covered stone arch at the entrance of an ancient underground dungeon, broken steps descend behind it, teal mushrooms and a warm amber lantern, distant soft blue moonlit grass outside. The left 40% stays visually quiet and dark with atmospheric stone texture for game controls. The hero is strongly readable against a cooler teal-blue background. A very tiny friendly grey rat peeks at the cow from the bottom right beside one forgotten milk bottle as a small easter egg. Classic modern low-resolution videogame pixel illustration, 400-by-225 logical resolution displayed enlarged in crisp pixels, restrained colors, atmospheric but hard pixel edges, no blurry painting and no 3D render. A thoughtful expressive character portrait with charm and adventure, not a logo or presentation board. Preserve the mascot identity accurately.
